# smallstep_browser (Resource)

Configuration to use a credential for browser mTLS.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "smallstep_browser" "intranet" {
  name            = "Intranet"
  match_addresses = ["https://smallstep.internal"]
  credentials     = [smallstep_credential.device.id]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `match_addresses` (List of String) List of URLs the configuration applies to.

### Optional

- `credentials` (Set of String) The UUID of credentials that the Smallstep agent will configure to use this browser integration.
- `name` (String) A human-friendly display name for this configuration.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The UUID of this protected browser configuration.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import smallstep_browser.intranet c5c053ae-78f2-47ef-a0c3-cdedd10403dd
```
